overview: You wrote that the king and the uncles are still one eloquence, and you left the cure for a morning. Kemp has not seen the page. You did not write Anne a better answer than the one you gave in April. Gib lay on the second volume while you wrote.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page and did not correct the king yet.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: Has not seen the page, and was not shown it.

key_provisions.text: the page Kemp has not seen

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Left the uncles as fine as the king, for one night

important_dates.meaning: The same eloquence, for one night more

summary: Left the uncles as fine as the king, for one night
